catalog_title: Comprehensive Research & Workspace Creator Skill Catalog
overview: Unified production capability catalog covering 615 skills across 41 categories and 15 specialist roles for research, retrieval, file-based knowledge, sandbox workspaces, dependencies, automation, verification, and sharing.

architect.purpose: Designs structural blueprints, data/storage schemas, permission boundaries, directory topologies, and interface contracts.

researcher.purpose: Executes primary source inspection, query formulation, evidence discovery, and corpus exploration.

planner.purpose: Builds ordered execution plans, task DAGs, milestone checklists, resource budgets, and risk mitigations.

operator.purpose: Executes the core domain engine on real files, records, queries, or workspace artifacts within configured bounds.

analyzer.purpose: Computes quantitative statistics, distributions, anomalies, structural profiles, and comparative insights.

builder.purpose: Constructs durable workspace artifacts, structured datasets, databases, templates, or deliverable files.

indexer.purpose: Builds searchable FTS5 lexical and TF-IDF semantic indexes, term dictionaries, and cross-reference catalogs.

verifier.purpose: Validates outputs against schemas, SHA-256 digests, factual source support, and consistency invariants.

coordinator.purpose: Routes upstream/downstream data contracts, resolves inter-stage dependencies, and prepares stage handoffs.

manager.purpose: Governs quotas, timeouts, retry budgets, approval states, retention policies, and lifecycle status.

auditor.purpose: Audits provenance completeness, truthfulness of operational claims, PII/secret hygiene, and license compliance.

automation-agent.purpose: Runs repeatable batch workflows, idempotency checks, rule-triggered pipelines, and checkpointed batch jobs.

recovery-specialist.purpose: Diagnoses failed or partial states, applies fallback strategies, cleans partial files, and resumes checkpoints.

packager.purpose: Assembles portable, checksummed, relative-path export bundles and shareable deliverables.

quality-evaluator.purpose: Evaluates completeness, provenance coverage, schema validity, determinism, and rubric benchmark scores.
